wages.text: Neal voted for the Raise the Wage Act and says he supports strong unions and fair wages.
wages.quote: Strong labor unions are one of the best ways to protect workers and ensure fair wages.

debt.text: Neal says he has worked to strengthen Social Security and supports increasing benefits.
debt.quote: Richie has worked to strengthen and enhance Social Security for all Americans.

immigration.text: Neal supports pathways to citizenship for DREAMers and other undocumented immigrants, along with expanded work visas.
immigration.quote: He believes that we must do more to create pathways to citizenship for undocumented immigrants

guns.text: Neal supports universal background checks and other gun safety measures, and voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.
guns.quote: a universal background check law would ensure that people prohibited from purchasing firearms cannot do so

abortion.text: Neal has called for restoring Roe and says health care decisions belong to patients and their doctors.
abortion.quote: Health care decisions belong between patients and their doctors. We’ve given Republicans multiple chances to protect those rights

gender.text: Neal voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would have set sports eligibility rules based on sex at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

cannabis.text: Neal supported the MORE Act, which would remove cannabis from the federal controlled substances list and regulate and tax it.
cannabis.quote: The MORE Act makes important changes to federal law by removing marijuana, or cannabis, from the list of federally controlled substances.

health.text: Neal says he supports universal coverage and protecting and improving the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: As we strive for universal coverage at the federal level, I continue to look at Massachusetts’ success.

energy.text: Neal helped advance the Inflation Reduction Act’s clean energy investments and emissions reduction goals.
energy.quote: The IRA supercharges our national efforts to fight climate change, using generous tax incentives to unleash the speedy development and deployment of clean energy production

voting.text: Neal voted for the For the People Act, which expanded early and absentee voting and established automatic voter registration.
voting.quote: Access to early and absentee voting will be expanded, and automatic voter registration will be established.

wages.text: She supports a job guarantee intended to provide a living wage to anyone who wants work.
wages.quote: Nadia supports an economic job guarantee so anyone who wants to work can earn a living wage doing work that strengthens our communities.

debt.text: She says she would raise Social Security benefits to keep pace with the cost of living.
debt.quote: She will fight to bring Social Security benefits in line with today’s cost of living so seniors can afford to live with dignity.

guns.text: She backs an assault-weapons ban, red-flag laws, and universal background checks.
guns.quote: She backs an assault weapons ban, red flag laws, and universal background checks, but says she is a gun owner who believes the 2024 Massachusetts state gun law priced rural families out of safety training.

health.text: She supports removing corporate insurance from health care and advancing Healthcare for All legislation.
health.quote: By driving popular Healthcare for All legislation, we will drastically lower costs so that you get the medical treatment you pay for.
